versions.description: Run around and shoot gd menus!

about:
# Menu Assault

Press T or whatever your keybind is to spawn the mod.

Hold right click to shoot the AK-47 (or change it to left click inside settings).

Doesn't work that well on popups but we ball.

Also don't forget to NOT shoot your exit/return buttons, thanks.

Have fun :D
